english: If you're in this area again,\nI hope you'll visit me.

This is a popular spot.

english: I can't keep going!\nI surrender!

english: Okay, when I move one day,\nthis place will be yours!
dutch: Oké, als ik ooit verhuis,\nwordt deze plek van jou!

english: This is a popular spot.\nIt's always taken.\pI waited a long time for it to open.\nI finally got to use it!
dutch: Dit is een populaire plek.\nHij is altijd bezet.\pIk wachtte lang tot hij vrij was.\nEindelijk mag ik hem gebruiken!

english: Welcome to my POKéMON LAB.\pI carry out research on battling in\nsecrecy.\pWould you like to see how strong I am?

english: I'm going to go all out!
dutch: Ik ga er helemaal voor!

english: Oh.\nSome other time, then!
dutch: Oh.\nDan een andere keer!

english: Hmm… I've still got lots to learn.\nI have to study some more.
dutch: Hmm… Ik moet nog veel leren.\nIk moet nog meer studeren.

english: Thanks for battling with me.\nPlease come back again tomorrow.
dutch: Bedankt voor het gevecht.\nKom morgen weer langs.

english: That was all in good fun!\nI should go enjoy shopping now.

english: People have told me that you can get\ndecorations in several ways.\pWe should have a race to see who can\nget nicer decorations and furniture!\pIn the meantime, want to battle?

english: This is my SECRET BASE.\nI can't lose!

english: I'll battle with you anytime.
dutch: Ik vecht altijd met je.
